title: Closer to SST: reverberation geometry/statistics, open-literature boundary models, spreading, waveforms, targets, validation
description: User: do all of the listed SST gaps. Reverberation (bistatic, motion, beams, K statistics); boundary models from open literature (Kirchhoff/composite roughness, bubble wind law, sediments); angle and frequency spreading; sampled transmit waveforms; aspect-dependent targets; seabed scatterers using the bottom model; reproduce TR 0702 checks.

title: SST equivalence: time spreading of boundary-bounce paths, bottom scattering model, volume layers, bubble loss
description: Close the gaps against TR 0702 in order: time spreading (Sec. 12), a Jackson-type bottom model from open literature, volume scattering layers, surface bubble loss. TR 9407 (limited distribution) is not available: substitutes must be stated.
close_reason: Implemented (time spreading, volume layers, bottom model, bubble loss); full CPU suite 59/59 at cb0c7b3

title: Host backend ran single-threaded in the gallery runs
description: tools/gallery.py --backend host used about one core per process (flank_patrol took 72 minutes). Check whether OpenMP is enabled in the host kernel build and in the simulator's synthesis, and whether the Python stages (reverberation, MVDR) can use threads.
close_reason: Done this round: sas_minsas_speckle; gpusonar.classify; host backend is multithreaded (the report was wrong) and synthesis is 5.7x faster

title: SAS survey scenes: seabed with developed speckle
description: The MINSAS survey scenes have 8 to 18 scatterers per square metre against about 2000 resolution cells, so the floor between them is empty and -47 dB along-track ambiguities of bright objects show. Needs a seabed with at least one scatterer per cell (about 2 million scatterers for the survey patch: GPU run) or a coherent statistical seabed model. Then re-measure whether the ghosts are covered.
close_reason: Done this round: sas_minsas_speckle; gpusonar.classify; host backend is multithreaded (the report was wrong) and synthesis is 5.7x faster

title: Classification after tracking (boat against boulder, ship against multipath)

Nothing separates targets from clutter except motion. Also: range correction for bottom-bounce paths in deep water (popoto_env_deep_silt_1000m shows the ship 300 m long in range).
